segments.ja387:3.1: Ito dāni patāyanti, sūciyo baḷisāni ca;
segments.ja387:4.1: Ito satthāni gacchanti, kammantā vividhā puthū;
segments.ja387:4.3: Koyaṃ kammāragāmasmiṃ, sūciṃ vikketumicchati [marahati (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja387:5.3: Ācariyāva jānanti [ācariyā sañjānanti (ka.), ācariyā pajānanti (syā.), ācariyāva sañjānanti (pī.)], kammaṃ sukatadukkaṭaṃ [dukkataṃ (sī. pī.)].
segments.ja387:6.1: Imaṃ ce [imañca (sī. syā. pī.)] te pitā bhadde, sūciṃ jaññā mayā kataṃ;
segments.ja387:6.3: Tayā ca maṃ nimanteyya, yañcatthaññaṃ ghare dhananti.
